messages:
PagerBot: ALERT: synthetic_probe_errors firing in eu-central-1 (severity=P2)
PagerBot: alert_id=synthetic_probe_errors:eu-central-1
Nora Kim: picking this up. Seeing a cluster of probe failures from the eur probe pool (~22 hosts). Customer metrics look OK so far but paging volume is spiking.
Theo Barnes: I see the same. Error type is connection timeout -> our fronting gateway returning 524 on the probe path. 70% of failures come from a single AZ (eu-central-1b).
Lina Rodriguez: can we gate the pager? This smells like a transient gateway overload not user-impacting.
Nora Kim: propose: mute on-call paging for this alert while we investigate probe-only signal. I'll add a silence scoped to label:probe=true and region=eu-central-1 for 40m.
Nora Kim: /silence synthetic_probe_errors region=eu-central-1 label=probe=true duration=40m note="investigating gateway timeouts"
PagerBot: Silence created: synthetic_probe_errors (40m) — muted channel: eng-oncall
Rajesh Nair: infra looking into gateway LB logs. Early read: connection queue spikes and 502s for internal health endpoints between 09:15–09:23 UTC. No increase in customer request errors.
Theo Barnes: Good. While infra digs, I'm going to reduce alert sensitivity so we don't page on a single-probe blip. Suggest short-term rule: require failure_ratio > 0.06 AND failures >= 4 across 5m for region. Also add for: 10m.
Theo Barnes: temp alert fragment I pushed to a branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/monitoring/pull/556 (WIP)
Lina Rodriguez: For long-term: we should make the probe algorithm less eager. Current cadence 20s is too bursty. Suggest moving to 45s interval + 2 retries + jitter, and change success threshold logic to use rolling 4m window aggregated by host groups.
Nora Kim: Agreed. Also add dedup by host group so a single misbehaving host doesn't fail the whole region.
Rajesh Nair: infra config I'll propose:
```yaml
probe:
  interval: 45s # increased from 20s
  timeout: 6s
  retries: 2
  jitter: 0.2
  grouping: host_group
  failure_window: 4m
  min_failures: 4
  require_fraction: 0.06
```
Rajesh Nair: I'll also add LB queue depth and internal conn-failure rate to the probe dashboard panels so we can correlate quickly.
Theo Barnes: Recommend adding a new alert label `probe_only=true` so Alertmanager routes to a muted route by default. Then critical customer-impact alerts do not get affected.
Lina Rodriguez: I'll add a CI test in the synthetic test harness to inject a 30s gateway blip and assert probes don't trigger a page. Ticket: COST-ops-129.
Nora Kim: Paging handoff: I'm on until 11:30 UTC, then Theo will take over. Leave detailed notes in the incident thread and mark runbook section to update.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-2031-12 — severity P2 — owners: Nora Kim, Rajesh Nair, Lina Rodriguez
Theo Barnes: Quick mitigation: applied temp alert change (non-escalating) + enabled silence. Confirming customer-facing SLOs unchanged.
Rajesh Nair: infra change pushed as WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1999 — adds retries and jitter for probe runner.
Lina Rodriguez: Dashboard work: adding two panels — probe failure heatmap by host_group and LB error_code breakdown (502/524). Will drop a link in the post-incident note.
Nora Kim: Capture artifacts: saved sample probe traces and gateway logs to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2031-12/trace-archive.log
Theo Barnes: We should also consider moving to a sliding percentile for latency checks (95th over 5m) instead of instantaneous thresholds. That will cut down flapping.
Lina Rodriguez: Noted. Will prototype percentile-based probe rules in the monitoring repo.
Rajesh Nair: After first-pass infra fix, I reran a local sim and saw failure spike damped by retries. Pushing for canary deploy of infra changes to one AZ first.
Nora Kim: Handoff note for Theo: keep the silence if customer errors remain absent, escalate if client-facing error rate or latency increases in any region. Update incident ticket with your timeline.
Theo Barnes: Taking handoff. I'll follow up with a brief post-incident action list and owners. Estimated time to have PRs merged (permanent): 1 week.
Lina Rodriguez: Post-incident doc checklist I'm owning: 1) update runbook section "synthetic-probes" 2) add Alertmanager route for probe_only label 3) add CI scenario and automation 4) update dashboards.
Nora Kim: Thanks team — nice controlled mitigation. Removing the temporary silence now; alert remains in a lower-sensitivity state until permanent rules land.
PagerBot: Silence ended: synthetic_probe_errors (was 40m)
Theo Barnes: Final notes — no customer-facing impact observed during event window. Filing follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/COST-ops-129 and tagging for SRE review.
Lina Rodriguez: +1 :white_check_mark: planning a retro tomorrow 11:00 UTC to validate proposed thresholds and probe cadence.
Nora Kim: Closing thread for now. If anything regresses ping on-call or reopen incident.
